set -e
export GNUPGHOME=/tmp/bg-manual-passphrase-repro
rm -rf "$GNUPGHOME"; mkdir -p "$GNUPGHOME"; chmod 700 "$GNUPGHOME"
gpg --batch --no-tty --quick-generate-key "Manual Repro <manual-repro@example.com>" default default 1y 2>&1 | tail -3

cat > /tmp/manual-repro/r.yaml <<'EOF'
name: r
runner: cli
binary: r
output_schema: text
EOF
go run ./cmd/beadle-daemon sign /tmp/manual-repro/r.yaml --signer "$FPR" || true
rm -rf /tmp/manual-repro "$GNUPGHOME"
go build ./... 2>&1 && golangci-lint run ./cmd/beadle-daemon/... 2>&1 && golangci-lint fmt --diff ./cmd/beadle-daemon/... 2>&1 && go test -race -count=1 ./cmd/beadle-daemon/... 2>&1 | tail -20
